index.title: Project Launcher

empty.adjustFilter: Try adjusting your search or filters.
empty.createHint: After creating it, pick an episode to start.

createDialog.title: New Project
createDialog.desc: After creating, go to the project page to pick an episode
createDialog.namePlaceholder: e.g. Urban Romance Short Drama "Time Post Office"
createDialog.aspectHint: Fixed after creation; video generation will use this ratio consistently

deleteDialog.title: Delete Project
deleteDialog.message: Delete "{title}"? Episodes, storyboards, and generation records under this project will all be deleted. This cannot be undone.

advancedToggle.label: Agent Advanced Settings
advancedToggle.note: Only expands Agent config and Skills. Workbench features and storyboard fields stay visible by default.

ai.title: AI Service Configuration
ai.desc: Use a recommended template to get set up quickly, then fine-tune by service type. Creating an episode in the workbench locks in the selected image and video capabilities.

quick.title: Huobao Quick Setup
quick.desc: Enter a Huobao API Key to write text, image, and video recommended configs in one go.

manual.title: Manual Templates
manual.desc: After choosing a service type, use a template to fill in a recommended `provider / base URL / model`.

serviceMeta.textDesc: Text Agent capabilities: script rewriting, character/scene extraction, storyboard breakdown, etc.
serviceMeta.imageDesc: Static image generation for characters, scenes, and shots
serviceMeta.videoDesc: Direct shot video generation, defaults to Seedance 2.0

ai.setDefaultModel: Set as default model for this type
ai.priorityHint: Higher values take priority. The workbench defaults to the highest-priority enabled config of the same type.
ai.temperatureHintOptional: (leave blank to use the provider's default)
ai.temperatureHint: Some models require a fixed temperature (e.g. the kimi-k2 series only allows 0.6) — set the required value here if you get an "invalid temperature" error.

toast.fillApiKey: Please enter a Huobao API Key
toast.temperatureRange: Temperature must be a number between 0 and 2

styles.title: Style Presets
styles.desc: Visual styles chosen at project creation. Their English prompt fragments are auto-injected into character and scene image generation. Disabled styles won't appear as creation options.

deleteDialog.title: Delete Style Preset
deleteDialog.message: Delete style "{name}"? Projects already using this style are unaffected, but a deleted built-in style may reappear after a restart — consider disabling it instead.

dialog.sub: Prompt fragments should be in English; they're appended automatically when generating character and scene images.
dialog.keyHint: The identifier stored on projects; cannot be changed after creation.
dialog.promptPlaceholder: e.g. anime style, cel shading, vibrant colors, clean line art
dialog.descPlaceholder: A one-line note on when to use this style

toast.requiredFields: Name, key, and prompt fragment are required

agents.title: Agent Configuration
agents.desc: The advanced section only keeps Agent runtime config. Adjust the model, prompt, and parameters here — changes apply immediately after saving.
agents.modelHint: (leave blank to use the AI service default)

toast.resetDone: Reset to default prompt (custom prompt file removed)

skills.desc: Skills are only an advanced prompt layer for the Agent; they don't affect the regular workbench feature entry points.

empty.title: No Skills yet
empty.desc: Click "New Skill" in the top right to create your first prompt file

addDialog.title: New Skill — {label}
addDialog.descPlaceholder: A short description of this Skill's purpose

deleteDialog.title: Delete Skill
deleteDialog.message: Delete Skill "{id}"? The corresponding Agent will fall back to its built-in default prompt.

dialogs.configSub: Recommended: pick a template first — the system will auto-fill a sensible `Base URL` and default model.

deleteDialog.title: Delete Episode
deleteDialog.message: Delete "{title}"? Once deleted it can no longer be viewed in the list, and its storyboards and generation records will become inaccessible.

storyboard.splitEmptyDesc: Split shots based on the script, characters, and scenes to generate shot descriptions and bindings.
